    # Try to read common fields safely; fall back to zero move if unavailable.

    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Basic safe defaults
    pos = observation.get("pos", None)
    safe = observation.get("safe", True)

    # Prefer staying in place if we can't determine anything useful
    if pos is None:
        return [dx, dy]

    # Determine simple heuristics from possible fields
    # Resource collection
    resource_dist = observation.get("resource_distance", None)
    if resource_dist is None:
        resource_dist = observation.get("nearest_resource_distance", None)

    if resource_dist is not None:
        # Move toward resource if it's nearby
        if resource_dist > 0:
            # Try to infer direction from a resource vector if available
            vec_x = observation.get("resource_dx", None)
            vec_y = observation.get("resource_dy", None)
            if vec_x is not None and vec_y is not None:

                dy = 0 if vec_y == 0 else (1 if vec_y > 0 else -1)
            else:

                rx = observation.get("resource_x_diff", None)
                ry = observation.get("resource_y_diff", None)
                if rx is not None and ry is not None:
                    dx = 0 if rx == 0 else (1 if rx > 0 else -1)
                    dy = 0 if ry == 0 else (1 if ry > 0 else -1)

    # Pursuit/Evasion: simple safety zone
    # If we have enemy/evader info, move away if very close
    evader_dist = observation.get("evader_distance", None)
    if evader_dist is None:
        evader_dist = observation.get("enemy_distance", None)

    if evader_dist is not None:
        if evader_dist <= 1:
            # move away from threat if we can discern a direction
            away_dx = observation.get("evader_dx", None)
            away_dy = observation.get("evader_dy", None)

                dx, dy = (0, 0)

    unknown_grid = observation.get("unknown_proportion", None)

    if unknown_grid is not None:
